answer.answer: Humayun's Tomb was chosen because its site on the banks of the Yamuna River was selected due to its proximity to the Nizamuddin Dargah, as burial near the celebrated Sufi saint was considered auspicious. Additionally, as the first grand garden-tomb on the Indian subcontinent, it is a magnificent UNESCO World Heritage Site featuring a Persian charbagh and striking red sandstone and white marble architecture.
